findings.summary: AssertExpectationsForObjects changed its type check from obj.(Mock) to obj.(*Mock), so Mock values passed by value fall through to an unchecked assertion and panic. Pointers now wrongly get the deprecation log.
Mock now holds a sync.Mutex by value, so copying a Mock copies the lock. go vet copylocks will flag this, and it is an API-visible change for users who embed or copy Mock.
